harm_loso.description: Offline linear diagnostic only. A=receiver metadata; B=A plus ego realized-error history; C=B plus peer realized-error history. All history features are strict causal prefixes.
harm_loso.label: peer_realized_error > ego_only_error + 0.1m

interpretation: all histories are strict causal receiver-observation prefixes; no GT or learned controller is used

short_to_long_harm.description: For the same scene/receiver/source/target, the latest or EWMA peer error already matured at send time predicts current long-horizon relative harm.
